newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks seen opening higher.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks seen opening higher.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to head higher at the opening on Thursday in a follow through to Wednesday's rally which was driven by the high techs.

"The futures are higher so we may follow through," said Larry Wachtel, analyst at Prudential Securities. "We had a strong tech rally. How we do for the rest of the day depends on the momentum of the high techs."
He said that the market would also be influenced by the outcome of today's U.S. Treasury auction of $12.5 billion in five-year notes.
